notes.title: New Update - the tutorial!
notes.content:
Hi Bikers!

Long time no see! In this update, we’re bringing you an [b]in-game tutorial[/b] to help some less advanced mechanics get their garage started :)

We want everyone to have fun when playing the game, and we know the beginning of the game can sometimes be quite overwhelming. Showing you some basic steps at the start will make the experience much more pleasant! 

In the tutorial, you will learn how to get commissions, get acquainted with the tools you have at your disposal in the garage, and learn the basics of the repair mechanism. Of course, there are still things to be discovered later, but it will give you an excellent head start and introduction to the game :)

notes.title: Biker Garage Anniversary Update - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hey, Bikers!

It’s been a long time coming, but we’re finally able to announce that in mid-December, a new version will be released as the Biker Garage Anniversary Update and it’s gonna be big! As you all probably already know the most important change will be the new interface, but that’s not it! We’ve also fixed the bugs reported by you in the past months.

Here are some of the bugs that have been fixed:

[list]
[*] Filtering the wishlist by category in the store we are in
[*] You can repair parts that are below 20%, contrary to what the tutorial and help section suggest
[*] You can drain the brake fluid to many liters in the minus. Additionally, the target amount may be -1 for a second
[*] You can paint a part with multiple colors and when you finish, the color of the whole part will change to the last one you’ve selected
[*] On weaker computers, the dynamometer does not display the generated information
[*] You can get stuck in the junkyard, due to the player's character falling very slowly
[*] The technical condition of all motorcycles in the parking lot shows 0%
[*] Incorrect speed measurement on the track
[*] Some parts fall below the junkyard and fall perpetually
[*] The tires have normal maps turned upside down and they shine too much
[/list]

notes.title: All Reviews: Mostly Positive. Yeah!
notes.content:
Hi!
It's the fourth day after the premiere. That was a hard time, but we are happy that we delivered the game to you.

We thank Biker Garage fans for all support and kindness that we received in the past few days, also at the entire process of development. It's great to see that after the first launch problems now most of you wrote good reviews and you are happy about the game.
Thank you for all the reviews, good and bad. We saw a lot of feedback there, and based on that, we plan how to improve the game. I want to share this plan with you and ask what do you think/what we miss from your feedback. We want to do what we did before - working with the community on our game. It worked previously, and I hope it'll work now too!

Features which we work on now:

- A lot of you ask for a tutorial. We think about adding feature - popup where you can see the description of how to handle things in-game with a short video. What do you think?
- Improving UI - adding an automated checklist to mission overview so that you can see your progress in the mission. At the next steps, reinventing the entire UI based on the style in the laptop. In this process, we want to add a new page with your progress in the game - like the mission that you solved or bikes that you fixed. What do you think? What should we add here?
- New motorcycle. Very soon :)
- Update with Junkyard!

And fixing minor problems in the game in the meantime. :)

Questions:
1. We received some feedback in bad reviews/refunds that we have a small number of features in the game. We think this problem is related to that we unlock new options too late. It seems that some players wait too long, and they believe that it is not more cool things in the game and leave. What do you think? Should we unlock features sooner?
2. What do you think about the game on the controller? What should we improve in this matter? We were thinking about auto-aim on screws, for example.
3. What should we add, in your opinion?
Thanks again for your support!
